headline: 円が156円台へ反発、日米財務相協議で介入警戒強まる
lead: ドル円は1日で2円超下落し157.18円、円の過小評価を日米が再確認したことで介入リスクが再び意識される。

knowledge.body_en:
Most Japanese companies close their fiscal year on March 31 and pay an interim dividend with a September 30 record date. To be on the register you must own the shares by the ex-dividend day, one business day earlier under T+2 settlement, so September 29 this year. Buying ahead of that cutoff is called kenri-tori, taking the right.

The effect is a mechanical bid in the last week of September, especially in high-yield banks, trading houses and utilities, followed by an ex-dividend drop roughly equal to the payout. Index futures price this in, so cash-versus-futures basis widens briefly. It rarely sets direction, but it can amplify a rally already under way.
knowledge.why_en: The Nikkei's fifth straight gain to 66,364 was helped by dividend buying that reverses after the September 29 ex-date.
